clips.title: The story
paras: Screaming Gully is the first sprawling subterranean cavern encountered just beyond the entrance of the Wailing Caverns. Bathed in unnatural fungal glow and shallow waters, it serves as the outer redoubt for the corrupted Druids of the Fang and their mutated beasts.

Stepping through the threshold of the Wailing Caverns leads directly into Screaming Gully, an echoing chasm where the wind groans through subterranean fissures. Far from the arid Barrens above, the gully is choked with damp overgrowth, humid mist, and aggressive wildlife twisted by the Emerald Nightmare. The Fanglord Lady Anacondra oversees the chamber, surrounded by acolytes of the Druids of the Fang and vicious deviate raptors, while ancient snapping turtles like Kresh patrol the shallow waterways below.
